caption_argument_segments: This infographic shows immature vs mature S&OP:
Variability ↳ Immature: assumes a stable plan and reacts when it breaks ↳ Mature: builds plans expecting variability from the start
Forecast ↳ Immature: single numbers, example: “Forecast = 100K” ↳ Mature: ranges, example: “Forecast = 90–110K, here’s how we respond”
Constraints ↳ Immature: discovers bottlenecks when service drops ↳ Mature: knows what will break before it does
Trade-offs ↳ Immature: avoids difficult choices ↳ Mature: makes trade-offs visible; service vs inventory; cost vs responsiveness
